freeze_policy: Questions and gold SQL frozen before any model output; no retrospective label changes.
comparison: Exact projected row and column count; numeric canonicalization only; ordered cases preserve row order; unordered cases compare full row multisets.

cases.question: Chinook库里哪个国家客户最多？请给出国家名称和客户数。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT country, count(*) FROM customer GROUP BY country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Chinook里销量最高的歌手是谁？请给出歌手名称和销量。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ar.name, sum(il.quantity) AS sold FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN album al ON t.album_id = al.album_id JOIN artist ar ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id GROUP BY ar.name ORDER BY sold DESC LIMIT 1
